items.title: started working on lob-alpha
items.body: Short-horizon price prediction from limit order book data

details.summary: Daniel started lob-alpha, a model that predicts the next few seconds of price movement from limit order book snapshots, then backtests a market-making strategy on those predictions.
highlights: Small LSTM over order book imbalance and bid-ask spread features
Walk-forward backtest that charges fees and slippage instead of assuming mid-price fills
Simulator core rewritten in C++ after the Python version got too slow
Latest commits add inventory limits so the market maker stops quoting when it holds too much
details.ask: How are you keeping the backtest from seeing future order book data?

items.summary: Sara launched ClubHub, a campus clubs app, and shipped a release with event reminders and dark mode.

details.summary: Sara shipped ClubHub v1.1, which reminds members before events they RSVP'd to and adds a dark mode.
highlights: Push reminders one hour before an event you RSVP'd to
Dark mode built from the design-system color tokens, not one-off colors
details.ask: How did you pick when to send the reminders?

items.title: launched clubhub
items.body:
Events and RSVPs for Georgia Tech clubs
Live at https://sarachen.github.io/clubhub

details.summary: Sara launched ClubHub, a React Native app where Georgia Tech clubs post events and members RSVP. It is live on the web.
highlights: One codebase for iOS, Android, and web with Expo
Clubs post events; members RSVP and export them to their calendar
Every screen uses the shared UI kit from Sara's design system
details.ask: Which clubs signed up first, and what did they ask for?

details.summary: Sara open-sourced clubhub-ui: Design-token UI kit behind ClubHub.
highlights: Recent work: add focus order to forms; tokens for dark mode
